priorFeedback.kickQuote: no difference, may a bit louder
priorFeedback.decision: Preserve that rejected kick experiment and change the rhythmic role/spectrum instead of increasing its gain.

sourceFeasibility.choice: Use source MIDI70 alone: it supplies30 attacks away from bass onsets with a lighter grid than the dense cabasa. No source GM hi-hat was selected or relabelled.
sourceFeasibility.sourceLabel: GM maracas; rendered through an original noise approximation, not faithful General MIDI or recovered Hülsbeck audio.

program.fixedAbsolutePitch: C6 (noise clock control, not an invented tonal score line)
program.basis: Ghostbusters static-noise patch3 supplies verified prior AD14/SR00 behavior; Hülsbeck bounded opening supplies the independent percussion-role example. Neither prior study establishes this trial’s sound or musical acceptance.

voiceAllocation.role: 68 source maracas attacks on otherwise vacant harmony voice

sourcePreservation.nativeDurationPolicy: Exact source durations remain in candidate score/origin records; native absolute boundaries are quantized and the existing gate inset plus TEST onset reduce gated noise body. No hidden extension, overlap trimming or invented percussion rhythm.
sourcePreservation.coldStart: The trial slices the same sourced hook from cold native state; this does not promise the complete baseline’s preceding envelope history.

comparison.reference: Same candidate SID with voice2 muted; voices1,3 retained
comparison.secondaryReference: Separate empty-harmony native score export is retained for technical comparison; its different CPU workload shifts store timing and it is not the primary audio A/B.

verification.bodyAndRelease: All68attacks have at least1gated noise body call. Executed gate clears agree with the converter at each note; waveform80 persists through release until the next TEST onset. Source durations are not equated to gated body.
verification.limits: Complete note scheduling/post-call and ordered store-value checks plus sampled VICE/cadence. Renderer muting is a diagnostic and does not produce additive stems; no continuous bus timing, hardware equivalence or musical acceptance is claimed.

signalContribution.scope: Nonzero contribution and unclipped signal are established. Useful drive, audibility and balance need the listener’s verdict; no gain increase or candidate revision was made.

modelAssistanceReview.decision: No model call: current calibration does not qualify rhythmic usefulness, annoyance or preference. Technical checks settle the changed source role and generated signal; the human listening verdict remains decisive.
modelAssistanceReview.nextCheckpoint: Scoped maracas trial feedback or substantive revision

executionTimingScope: Final checked invocation reused native/render stages; not a cold benchmark.
acceptanceQuestion: Does the added maracas noise give the hook useful rhythmic movement while keeping the melody clear, or does it compete with it?
